The supplied historical exam outlines do not agree on one question count or set of sections. A 2018 edition lists ten groups and 140 questions. An undated international version lists eight groups. A 2021 international outline lists twelve groups and 120 questions, including 20 trial items. [Added context] An official 2024-03-22 outline also lists twelve areas and 120 questions. See Contrary evidence for how these versions relate. Requirements for a specific future sitting must still be confirmed with the provider.
